longTitle.officialTitle: Making emergency supplemental appropriations for additional disaster assistance, for anti-terrorism initiatives, for assistance in the recovery from the tragedy that occurred at Oklahoma City, and making rescissions for the fiscal year ending September 30, 1995, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.content: That the following sums are appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to provide emergency supplemental appropriations for additional disaster assistance, for anti-terrorism initiatives, for assistance in the recovery from the tragedy that occurred at Oklahoma City, and making rescissions for the fiscal year ending September 30, 1995, and for other purposes, namely:

chapter.heading: DEPARTMENTS OF COMMERCE, JUSTICE, AND STATE, THE JUDICIARY, AND RELATED AGENCIES

compsdtd:appropriations-para.compsdtd:text: For an additional amount for International Broadcasting Operations, $7,290,000, for transfer to the Board for International Broadcasting to remain available until expended.
Of the unobligated balances available under this heading, $2,000,000 are rescinded.
Of the unobligated balances available under this heading, $16,000,000 are rescinded.
Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–317, $5,000,000 are rescinded.
